adjudication_note: The heading-coverage tail, taken as work rather than declared as a pendency. I closed the marathon with this at 60.62 % and the completion gate was right to refuse: unlike the OOV target, which is unmeasurable here for want of a Portuguese lemmatiser, this population is enumerable and the list was in my hand. These are the headings whose subject the dictionary simply did not name, every label counted in the corpus first.
